title: What Pages Every Local Business Website Needs

segments.text: 76% of people check your website before they ever call you.

segments.narration: Most people do their research before picking up the phone. If your website does not answer their basic questions — what you do, where you are, and how to reach you — they move on to someone who does. Your site is your first impression, and most of the time you are not there to make it in person.

Businesses with a dedicated Contact page get three times more inquiries than those that only have a phone number in the footer. Not just a link — a full page with your address, your hours, a map, and a form. Most small business sites skip it entirely and wonder why people are not calling.

segments.title: Pages Visitors Check on a Local Business Website
segments.narration: When someone finds your site, here is where they go. Almost everyone hits the home page, but 74 percent navigate straight to your Services page — that is your most important content. 61 percent look for a Contact page. If those pages are missing or hard to find, you are losing the customers who were already interested.
The full breakdown on all five pages and what to put on each one is linked in the comments.
